column8: Ensure DTLS traffic is using v1.2 (version offered in the ClientHello body) and strong ciphersuites. The allowed ciphersuites are set via the      MMT_SEC_DTLS_CIPHER_ALLOWLIST environment variable which contains a comma-separated list of cipher numbers; when it is unset, only the version is checked.     Example MMT_SEC_DTLS_CIPHER_ALLOWLIST='0xc0a4,0xc0a5' will allow TLS_PSK_WITH_AES_128_CCM and TLS_PSK_WITH_AES_256_CCM ciphers (SCSV and GREASE values are ignored)
